explain.say: Lizards are ectotherms, often called cold-blooded: they get their body heat from their surroundings, not from burning food. On a cool morning a lizard is slow and sluggish.

faq.q: Why are lizards slow when they are cold?
faq.a: A lizard's body is about as warm as its surroundings. When it is cold, the chemical reactions in its muscles and nerves run slowly, so it moves and reacts slowly too.
They bask in the sun, flatten their bodies to catch more rays, angle themselves side-on to the sun, lie on warm rocks, and some darken their skin to absorb more heat.
asks: Why do lizards lie on rocks?
Do lizards change colour to warm up?

faq.q: What is a lizard's best temperature?
faq.a: Each species has a preferred body temperature where it runs, hunts and digests best. For many desert lizards it is around 30 to 38 degrees Celsius, and they move between sun and shade to stay near it.
asks: How warm do lizards like to be?
Why do lizards move in and out of the shade?

faq.a: They move into shade or burrows, face into the wind, or stand tall on their toes to lift their bodies off hot sand. Some desert lizards lift their feet in turn in a little dance.
asks: Why do some lizards dance on sand?

faq.a: Not really. Because lizards do not burn food to make heat, they need far less food than a mammal of the same size. They can survive where food is scarce, though they are slow when cold.
asks: Why do reptiles eat less than mammals?
Is it better to be warm-blooded?

facts: Lizards are ectotherms: they control their body temperature mainly by moving between warmer and cooler places.
Because they do not generate body heat from food, reptiles need far less food than mammals of similar size.

quiz.say: Why does a lizard bask in the morning sun?
quiz.show: A lizard basks in the morning to…

options.show: Warm its body so it can move and digest well
options.say: Warm its body so it can move and digest well

options.show: Dry out its scales after swimming
options.say: Dry out its scales after swimming

quiz.why: As an ectotherm it needs outside heat to reach the temperature where its body works best.

wrong.1: Warmth, not skin chemistry, is the main reason for basking.
wrong.2: Most lizards are not swimmers; they bask for warmth.
